name: Agentic Diagnostics

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, docs ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, docs ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: Build
        run: go build ./...

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: Test
        run: go test ./...

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: Install golangci-lint
        run: |
          curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golangci/golangci-lint/master/install.sh | sh -s -- -b $(go env GOPATH)/bin v1.55.2
      - name: Run golangci-lint
        run: golangci-lint run ./...

  validate-schema:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Validate Safe Inputs JSON Schema
        uses: dsanders11/json-schema-validate-action@v1.4.0
        with:
          schema: docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json
          files: docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json
          fail-on-invalid: true
          all-errors: true
